$comment: E2E quarantine registry — issue #7 (pay down the CI E2E debt).
Every entry here is a test that fails in CI for an environment reason we have
not fixed yet, and is therefore EXCLUDED from the blocking gate via
--grep-invert. Nothing is silently dropped: `node scripts/e2e-quarantine.mjs
check` fails when an entry no longer matches exactly one test, so a renamed
or repaired test can't leave a stale exemption behind, and the weekly
e2e-quarantine-sweep workflow runs the FULL suite (including these) so they
don't rot unseen.
Removal policy: fix the cause, delete the entry, confirm the sweep is green.
`match` is a unique substring of the test's full title.
RETIRED 2026-09-23: the five developer-portal entries (integrations,
destructive-confirm-glyphs, playground) were removed after all 15 specs passed
against a FRESH provisioned Postgres with zero code changes — the CI red was
shared-DB drift, and the seed now ships those fixture rows (guarded by
npm run check:seed, which runs in the seed-fixture CI job).
RETIRED 2026-09-23 — ALL REMAINING 13 ENTRIES. The registry is now empty; the
blocking gate runs the full suite. Each entry's real cause and fix:
· 2fa-modal-mobile 'TOTP prompt fits the viewport' — the spec never walked the
verify-method chooser (it expected the TOTP prompt straight after "Log in").
Fixed in the spec: chooser → 'Use authenticator app' → TOTP prompt.
· smooth-scroll 'hero scroll cue glides' — two real defects: (a) the glide
trace's 1px monotonicity tolerance read view-transition snapshot resets
(deep one-to-three-bucket dips that immediately RECOVER) as scroll
reversals, and (b) the footer '#' probe's pre-scroll ran under CSS
scroll-behavior:smooth, so the fragment jump competed with an in-flight
animation and was swallowed (scrollY stuck at ~9848 with '#' in the URL).
Fixed: dip-and-recover detection in the assertion, settle-the-pre-scroll
in the spec, and the view-transition provider no longer intercepts bare
'#' links (it was pushing '/path#' through the router, which scrolls
nothing — a real product bug in every footer placeholder link).
· ai-copilot-mobile / dashboard-tabs-mobile — hydration-timing reads; the
specs now wait for their mount signals before measuring geometry.
· affiliate-lifecycle (x2) — the seed ships the PENDING/APPROVED/SCHEDULED
affiliate fixture; the old CI red was the shared dev DB missing it. Now
guarded by check:seed.
· backup-restore-verify — same class: the seed's scheduler-run ledger state
is present on a fresh seed; verified green against a fresh database.
· trial-lifecycle — the spec read DATABASE_URL only from .env files, which do
not exist in CI; it now prefers process.env.DATABASE_URL.
· midtrans-settlement-invoice — same DATABASE_URL gap, plus the sandbox
server key: the spec now reads MIDTRANS_SANDBOX_SERVER_KEY from the
environment and SKIPS with an explicit annotation when it is absent
(wired through the reusable workflow's secrets map).
· pricing-fx-rates — clicked the currency switcher before hydration; now
waits for networkidle first.
· security-telemetry-burst (x2) — the real blocker: these specs must FILL a
window (and read 'used of 10'), but CI raises the suite-wide budget to 500
so a 14-request burst can never throttle. They now pin their own window via
the E2E-only x-e2e-throttle-limit header (src/lib/rate-limit.ts — ignored
when NODE_ENV=production), making 429s and 'of 10' deterministic under any
suite-wide budget.
· two-factor-auth 'trusts a device for 30 days' — TOTP single-use: consecutive
tests could land in the SAME 30s window and reuse a code the replay guard
(RFC 6238 §5.2) had already spent. freshCode() now never repeats the last
issued code, waiting out the window when it would.
